source: Lets make 3d game with floating island kingdoms with waterfalls,brigdes and a giant crystal castle and around the island you can find 5 diffrent temples with 5 diffrent bosses you can fight and earn coins to unlock new weapons and when you first start make the player equip a katana and when the equip it make some mobs spawn for them to fight so they can updgrade from a katana. also make it when you have 1,000 coins you can create your own clans to go out on adventures and experience and fight new enemies. also make the map 1,000,000,000,000 blocks big. and when you get enough xp make it so you can level up and unlock new maps and the max level right now is level 5,000.

answers.ask: A trillion blocks is not buildable - do you want one island cluster you can cross in a couple of minutes, or a set of separate maps unlocked as you level?
answers.answer: Use a set of separate maps unlocked as the player levels up; this keeps the huge-world feeling while making progression playable.

answers.ask: Crystal castle plus katana could read as bright anime-fantasy or as solemn high fantasy - which look do you want?
answers.answer: Use a bright anime-fantasy look, with colorful floating islands, glowing crystals, and dramatic waterfalls.

answers.ask: Are the five temples on the main island, or is each one its own floating island reached by bridge?
answers.answer: Make each of the five temples its own floating island reached by bridges from the main crystal-castle island.

scene_prompt: Create a bright anime-fantasy 3D game map built as a cluster of colorful floating islands with glowing crystals and dramatic waterfalls dropping into the clouds below. The central main island holds a giant crystal castle, with five separate temple islands arranged around it and connected by long bridges; each temple is visually distinct and serves as a boss arena. Design this as the starting map within a set of separate level-unlocked maps, creating the feeling of a vast world without one continuous trillion-block landmass.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is RPG: progression, combat bosses, weapon upgrades, and level-unlocked world maps define the game. There is no secondary genre.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-chaptered`, taken from outside RPG’s usual shape set. This makes the starting floating-island kingdom one chapter/map within a larger sequence of separately unlocked maps, rather than attempting a continuous trillion-block world. Preset: none; the map retains an RPG hub-and-boss structure but its five boss sites coexist as bridge-linked islands rather than separate dungeon instances.

### Config requirements
Use `landmark-focal` for the giant glowing crystal castle as the central visual anchor. Use `island-cluster` for the central island plus five distinct temple islands suspended over the clouds. Use `water-body` for the dramatic waterfalls spilling from island edges into the cloud layer below.

### Layout requirements
Use `spawner-npc` with five boss origins: one centered or deeply set within each temple island’s boss arena, away from the bridge arrival point so each approach has a readable combat staging area. No other placed gameplay elements are required by the scene.

### Layout components
Build one starting-map chapter as a radial floating-island cluster. The largest central island contains the giant crystal castle, broad arrival grounds, luminous crystal outcrops, and the bridge junctions. Arrange exactly five separate temple islands around it, each visibly distinct in silhouette, color accents, roofline, and arena dressing; each is a self-contained boss arena. Connect every temple island directly to the central island with one long, readable bridge, preserving clear traversal between the hub and all five destinations. Waterfalls descend from the castle island and selected temple-island cliffs into clouds below. The boundary is open sky and cloud void, with no continuous land beyond the island edges. Frame the castle at the composition center, with the five temples distributed around it and bridges forming a clear star-like plan.

### Render order
Render `topdown` first and treat it as authoritative, because all five bridges must form valid, readable connections between the central island and the boss islands; the isometric render is then dressed from that connected plan.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale band: huge in implied world scope, expressed as a substantial starting-map cluster and separate future level-unlocked maps rather than one literal trillion-block surface. Theme: bright anime fantasy, colorful floating islands, glowing crystals, and dramatic cloudfall waterfalls. Use `P4` because later progression maps are separate maps, and `CHECK` because the separated floating islands and open cloud void require verification that the represented surfaces remain legible from above.
